feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: Families of journalists killed in Ukraine sue Fox News for failing to keep them safe
entry.summary: Fox News is being sued by families of two journalists killed in Ukraine four years ago. They say the network failed to keep their loved ones safe.

entry.title: Do fraternities fuel sexual assaults on campus?
entry.summary: Fraternities are at the center of recent debate over sexual assault on campus. Studies show Greek life is linked to higher rates of sexual assault, but researchers say it's a broader systemic problem.

entry.title: Latter-day Saints women turn away from scandal-plagued Republican candidate in Arizona
entry.summary: Arizona Republican candidate for Congress Mark Lamb has been accused of sexual misconduct while sheriff. His controversy is turning many voters away as Democrats see an opportunity in the red seat.

entry.title: Coast Guard finds debris from medical plane carrying 6 people
entry.summary: Flight data shows the jet dropped at least 9,000 feet over two minutes, then leveled off for several more minutes, before disappearing.

entry.title: 'It's not just a Cornell problem': Students speak out about sexual assault
entry.summary: Women are posting videos hashtagged #IAmJaneDoe to support the woman suing Cornell. Students across the country say her case raises concerns about safety on campus.

entry.title: Can the Cornell lawsuit force changes that make students safer?
entry.summary: Universities have responsibilities when students report sexual assault, even if prosecutors don't bring charges. Attorney Baine Kerr explains how those protections work.

entry.title: From saunas to psychedelics, how a health reporter sorts science from hype
entry.summary: A reporting trip to a sauna conference in Oslo found NPR's Will Stone in a sauna with his clothes and recording gear. In this reporter's notebook, he explains how he investigates the science behind wellness claims.

entry.title: Year-end countdown: The federal ban threatening to upend the THC drink boom
entry.summary: Farmers and businesses face a looming federal ban on hemp-derived THC products. It is set to go into effect at the by year-end, threatening to upend a multibillion-dollar market for low-dose drinks.

entry.title: All's fair in love and 'War' — a well-cast, classy-trashy divorce drama
entry.summary: HBO's War is intended to be an anthology series about two dueling London law firms. The first season stars Dominic West and Sienna Miller as a high-profile couple in the midst of a very nasty divorce.

entry.title: Just short of its 200th birthday, a landmark natural history museum shuts down
entry.summary: Beloved for its dinosaurs, Philadelphia's storied Academy of Natural Sciences closed down this week, amid an intense fight by local residents, politicians and scientists to save it.
